title: When Do Pretrained Audio Representations Help Music Recommendation? A Study Across Ranking and Generative Interfaces
abstract: arXiv:2608.06928v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Pretrained audio encoders are increasingly used to provide content representations for music recommendation, but their downstream value can change substantially with the recommendation interface through which they are used. We study this effect across six pretrained audio encoders and three representative settings: content-based retrieval, sequential recommendation, and Semantic-ID-based generative recommendation. Using matched random-feature and ID-only controls, we distinguish absolute recommendation performance from gains over content-free inputs. Across two music datasets and a full-catalog evaluation, music-pretrained and audio-text-aligned encoders are generally stronger when their pretrained geometry is used directly or converted into Semantic IDs, while these differences become much smaller after interaction-based adaptation in SASRec. translated_title: 预训练音频表征何时有助于音乐推荐？跨排序与生成式界面的研究
translated_abstract: 预训练音频编码器正越来越多地被用于为音乐推荐提供内容表征，但其实际下游价值会随所使用的推荐界面不同而发生显著变化。我们在六个预训练音频编码器和三种代表性场景中研究了这一效应：基于内容的检索、序列推荐以及基于语义ID（Semantic-ID）的生成式推荐。通过使用匹配的随机特征对照和仅ID对照，我们将绝对推荐性能与相对于无内容输入的提升区分开来。在两个音乐数据集和全目录评估中，音乐预训练和音频-文本对齐的编码器在直接使用其预训练几何结构或将其转换为语义ID时通常表现更强，而在SASRec中经过基于交互的适配后，这些差异变得小得多。我们进一步研究了在生成式推荐中应如何对音频表征进行离散化……
tldr: 该研究发现预训练音频表征对音乐推荐的价值高度依赖于推荐界面——音乐预训练和音频-文本对齐编码器在基于内容检索和语义ID生成式推荐中带来明显增益，但在SASRec序列推荐中经交互适配后优势大幅缩小。
en_tdlr: This study shows that the value of pretrained audio representations for music recommendation depends heavily on the interface: music-pretrained and audio-text-aligned encoders yield clear gains in content-based retrieval and Semantic-ID generative recommendation, but their advantages shrink substantially after interaction-based adaptation in SASRec.
